Hi Megan —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As we discussed, I'd like to kick off a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on renewal + a scoped expansion for Q1 that targets two things: a tighter evaluation plan for your new inference-heavy use cases, and a defined procurement/close timeline so your finance and procurement teams can plan.

High-level goals for the MAP:
- Confirm renewal terms for current footprint by 2027-01-15
- Evaluate two pilot workloads (batch embed pipeline + low-latency chat) and agree on acceptance criteria
- Define capacity and pricing band for expansion (targeting +40% token volume)

Proposed initial attendees (please add or replace):
- Altiora: Megan Hill (you), Tom Ruiz (Procurement), Elena Park (Eng)
- Redwood: Kimberly Park (account lead), Marcus Lin (CS/usage), Vivek Kulkarni (solutions)

Draft artifacts attached: Altiora-MAP-Draft-v1.pdf (MAP template with milestones) and usage-report-Nov-2026.csv (recent usage snapshot).

Can we schedule a 45-minute kickoff this week or early next? I’m available Wed 12/02 10:00–12:00 PT or Thu 12/03 09:00–11:30 PT; happy to accommodate other times.

Next steps I’ll take after we agree on a slot:
1) Finalize MAP doc with owners & milestones
2) Share an evaluation checklist for the two pilot workloads (SLOs, sample data, measurement plan)
3) Run a quick cost/upsell sketch for the +40% volume scenario for finance

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Kim / Marcus — quick internal note before we lock the invite:

Notes on evaluation & upsell approach:
- Evaluation checklist: we'll deliver a 2-week smoke validation for each pilot (one week setup + 1 week measured traffic), with objective metrics: p50/p95/p99 latencies for chat, per-token cost estimates for the embed pipeline, and end-to-end success rate for typical prompts. Marcus to define the exact acceptance thresholds for SRE sign-off.
- Data & infra: request Altiora provide a 24–48 hour sample of production traffic for the low-latency scenario and a 48–72 hour export for batch embeds. We'll provide a sanitized test harness.
- Pricing/upsell sketch: propose two uplift bands based on committed volume: 20% uplift = 10% discount vs list; 40% uplift = 18% discount + 30 days of priority support. If procurement needs firm numbers earlier, I can run a non-binding price sketch before the kickoff meeting (will attach a short pricing memo).

I recommend we include a short section in the MAP for rollback/fallback (model variant to cheaper quantized models) so Altiora's engineering team can plan for graceful degradation.

I'll prepare the pricing memo and a one-page evaluation checklist before the kickoff.

– Vivek
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
